queries.sql: SELECT clp_schema() FROM westermo.events  ORDER BY field_path
SELECT clp_schema_tree() AS schema_tree FROM westermo.events
SELECT clp_schema() FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.load_1m::DOUBLE >= 2 ORDER BY field_path
SELECT clp_schema_tree() AS schema_tree FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.load_1m::DOUBLE >= 2

SELECT clp_schema() FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1' AND _events.load_1m::DOUBLE IS NOT NULL AND _events.timestamp::BIGINT >= 0 AND _events.timestamp::BIGINT < 3600 ORDER BY field_path

SELECT clp_schema_tree() AS schema_tree FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1' AND _events.load_1m::DOUBLE IS NOT NULL AND _events.timestamp::BIGINT >= 0 AND _events.timestamp::BIGINT < 3600
SELECT clp_schema() FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.load_1m::DOUBLE > _events.load_15m::DOUBLE ORDER BY field_path
SELECT clp_schema_tree() AS schema_tree FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.load_1m::DOUBLE > _events.load_15m::DOUBLE
SELECT * FROM (SELECT clp_schema() FROM westermo.events) f WHERE starts_with(field_path,'cpu_') ORDER BY field_path
SELECT clp_schema() FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.load_1m::DOUBLE > 1e100

queries.operation: Field history in original units: first
queries.sql: SELECT clp_first_seen(_events.load_1m, _events.timestamp::BIGINT) AS first_seen FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1'

queries.operation: Field history in original units: last
queries.sql: SELECT clp_last_seen(_events.load_1m, _events.timestamp::BIGINT) AS last_seen FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1'

queries.operation: Field history in original units: both
queries.sql: SELECT clp_first_seen(_events.load_1m, _events.timestamp::BIGINT) AS first_seen, clp_last_seen(_events.load_1m, _events.timestamp::BIGINT) AS last_seen FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1'
SELECT field_path,first_seen,last_seen,matching_rows FROM clp_dataset_fields('westermo', time_path='timestamp', start_value=0, predicate='_events.system_id::VARCHAR=''system-1''') ORDER BY field_path

queries.operation: Field history with a value predicate
queries.sql: SELECT clp_first_seen(_events.load_1m, _events.timestamp::BIGINT) AS first_seen, clp_last_seen(_events.load_1m, _events.timestamp::BIGINT) AS last_seen FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1' AND _events.load_1m::DOUBLE >= 2

queries.operation: First/last aggregate with explicit clock conversion
queries.sql: SELECT epoch_ms(clp_first_seen(_events.load_1m, epoch_ms(_events.timestamp::BIGINT * 1000))) // 1000 AS first_seen,epoch_ms(clp_last_seen(_events.load_1m, epoch_ms(_events.timestamp::BIGINT * 1000))) // 1000 AS last_seen FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1'

queries.operation: Raw relative clock is not a declared timestamp
queries.sql: SELECT clp_first_seen(_events.load_1m,_events.timestamp),clp_last_seen(_events.load_1m,_events.timestamp) FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.system_id::VARCHAR='system-1'
SELECT clp_string_shape(_events.system_id::VARCHAR) AS shape,count(*) AS n FROM westermo.events  GROUP BY shape ORDER BY n DESC,shape
SELECT clp_string_shape(_events.system_id::VARCHAR) AS shape,count(*) AS n FROM westermo.events WHERE _events.load_1m::DOUBLE >= 2 GROUP BY shape ORDER BY n DESC,shape
